user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your AuraMon device.

webhook.description:
Setup is almost done. Readings are pushed to Home Assistant rather than polled, so copy this webhook URL into the device's Home Assistant uploader settings (`url`/`webhook_id`):

`{webhook_url}`

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host and that the device is powered on.

init.description:
Change the IP address or hostname of this Aura Mon device. This is the webhook URL for this Aura Mon device. Paste it into the device's Home Assistant uploader settings (`url`/`webhook_id`) if it isn't receiving data:

`{webhook_url}`

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host and that the device is powered on.
error.wrong_device: That host is a different Aura Mon device than the one configured.
